name: VETER
description: VETER: Geometry Dash 2.2 tools with a compact four-tab menu (Player, GD Bot, Visuals, Settings) with a visible main-menu button, multi-slot macro recording/playback/Continue, speed controls, overlays, editor transform helpers and local unlock checks. Some advanced bypasses are not implemented.

noclip-enabled.name: NoClip
noclip-enabled.description: Toggle NoClip from the VETER menu.

fps-bypass-enabled.name: FPS Bypass
fps-bypass-enabled.description: Unlock the requested frame interval; hardware and display refresh rate may limit actual FPS.

fps-target.name: FPS Target
fps-target.description: Target FPS used while FPS Bypass is enabled.

auto-retry-enabled.name: Auto-Retry
auto-retry-enabled.description: Restart the level after player death.

hitboxes-enabled.name: Show Hitboxes
hitboxes-enabled.description: Use the game built-in debug draw mode.

practice-music-enabled.name: Practice Music Hack
practice-music-enabled.description: Toggle the game built-in practice music behavior.

noclip-limit-enabled.name: Noclip Limit
noclip-limit-enabled.description: Allow up to the configured number of ignored collisions before normal death is restored.

noclip-max-deaths.name: Noclip Collision Limit
noclip-max-deaths.description: Maximum ignored collisions before NoClip is disabled for this attempt (1–50).

frame-step-enabled.name: Frame Step
frame-step-enabled.description: Freeze PlayLayer updates until Step +1 is pressed.

no-death-effect-enabled.name: No Death Effect
no-death-effect-enabled.description: Suppress the player's death visual effect without preventing death.

hitboxes-on-death-enabled.name: Show Hitboxes on Death
hitboxes-on-death-enabled.description: Temporarily enable the game's debug hitbox draw after a player death.

confirm-exit-enabled.name: Confirm Exit
confirm-exit-enabled.description: Ask before leaving a level from the pause menu.

unlock-all-enabled.name: Unlock All Checks
unlock-all-enabled.description: Override local item-unlocked checks; does not grant currency or server progress.

shop-unlock-bypass-enabled.name: Shop Unlock Check
shop-unlock-bypass-enabled.description: Override the local shop-item unlocked status check; purchases may still require currency.

vault-bypass-enabled.name: Vault Unlock Check
vault-bypass-enabled.description: Override local secret, gauntlet and special-chest unlocked status checks.

layout-mode-enabled.name: Layout Mode
layout-mode-enabled.description: Show a translucent 32-pixel reference grid during gameplay.

icon-kit-bypass-enabled.name: Icon Kit Checks
icon-kit-bypass-enabled.description: Override local icon unlock checks; does not write permanent save progress.

main-levels-bypass-enabled.name: Main Levels Checks
main-levels-bypass-enabled.description: Override the local has-completed check for official main levels; this is not a server or save unlock.

text-length-bypass-enabled.name: Text Length Bypass
text-length-bypass-enabled.description: Raise CCTextInputNode max length for fields that use this API.

trajectory-enabled.name: Position Trail
trajectory-enabled.description: Draw a short historical trail behind the player; this is not a future trajectory predictor.

show-clicks-enabled.name: Show Clicks
show-clicks-enabled.description: Briefly show a click marker near the player after input.

custom-menu-music-enabled.name: Custom Menu Music
custom-menu-music-enabled.description: Play custom-menu.mp3 from the mod save directory while in menus.

transparent-pause-enabled.name: Transparent Pause
transparent-pause-enabled.description: Lower the opacity of the pause UI when it opens.

hide-pause-button-enabled.name: Hide Pause Button
hide-pause-button-enabled.description: Hide the visible in-level pause button after the mod finds it.

editor-move-step.name: Editor Move Step
editor-move-step.description: Movement step used by the Editor tab (0.1, 1, or 10).

editor-scale-step.name: Editor Scale Step
editor-scale-step.description: Scale increment used in the Editor tab.

speedhack-enabled.name: Speedhack
speedhack-enabled.description: Change game time scale while a level is active.

music-muted.name: Music Mute
music-muted.description: Pause or resume the game music.

music-speed-sync.name: Music Speed Sync
music-speed-sync.description: Scale level music pitch with the Speedhack multiplier. Requires an active level music channel.
